entities.name: Batar Throatslasher
entities.description: A Mardu warrior and one of three wing leaders of Zurgo's warband in Tarkir's original timeline; he challenged Zurgo and was killed.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Leader of the Mardu warband who accepted Batar's challenge and killed him.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: The Temur khan whom Zurgo's warband set out to hunt down.

entities.name: Varuk
entities.description: A Mardu who joined Batar in objecting to entering Temur territory.

entities.name: Rufaz
entities.description: A Mardu who joined Batar in objecting to entering Temur territory.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker spotted invading Temur territory, which prompted the Temur attacks on the Mardu.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The warrior clan of Tarkir to which Batar and Zurgo belong.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir whose warriors attacked the Mardu in their mountains.

events.summary: Zurgo's warband, including Batar, beats back attacking Temur warriors and learns the attack was prompted by Sarkhan Vol invading Temur territory.
Zurgo announces the Mardu will enter Temur territory to hunt Surrak; Batar, Varuk and Rufaz object, but Batar is the last to nod his acceptance.
events.quote: Batar was the last to nod his acceptance.

events.summary: An unnatural blizzard strikes the Mardu in the Temur mountains and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back, calling it a trap.
events.quote: Batar rode up next to Zurgo and told him to turn back from this absurd venture.

events.summary: The Temur ambush the Mardu from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu; Zurgo hands out battle names to newly blooded warriors and Batar angrily challenges him.
events.quote: Temur struck from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu and losing only twenty of their numbers.

events.summary: Batar challenges Zurgo for the right to lead the Mardu and the two duel; Zurgo punches him down.
events.quote: Batar then challenged Zurgo for the right to lead the Mardu.

events.summary: Zurgo runs Batar through the chest and kills him.
events.quote: Zurgo ran his sword straight through Batar's chest
